# openwrt_package (Resource)

Installs a package with opkg (OpenWrt <= 24.10) or apk (>= 25.x), detected automatically. Uses LuCI's package-manager helper, which the stock `luci-app-package-manager` ACL already allows. Note that packages installed this way are lost on sysupgrade unless kept by attended sysupgrade.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Package name, e.g. `luci-app-sqm`.

### Optional

- `keep_on_destroy` (Boolean) Leave the package installed when the resource is destroyed.
- `update_lists` (Boolean) Refresh package lists before installing. Default true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `version` (String) Installed version.
